title: Settings for the software factory
description: The settings file, .claude/factory.yaml. An editor's help: `factory config check` is the check that counts.

version.description: The shape of this file, not the factory's version. Must be 1.

repository.description: The repository's owner and name, as owner/name.

tickets.description: Where tickets live and how their state is shown.

specs.description: How the written spec for a visible change is kept: openspec, or none.

before-commit.description: Commands run from the repository's root before every commit a session makes. If one fails, the commit is blocked.

build-setup.description: Commands run from the repository's root before an unattended build starts work.

tickets.description: Where tickets live and how their state is shown.

board.description: The number at the end of your GitHub Project's address, or none. Default: none.

tickets.columns.description: Which of your board's columns shows each state. Needs a board.

backlog.description: The board's column for the backlog state. Default: Backlog.

refining.description: The board's column for the refining state. Default: In refinement. May be none.

ready.description: The board's column for the ready state. Default: Ready. May be none.

building.description: The board's column for the building state. Default: In progress. May be none.

review.description: The board's column for the review state. Default: In review. May be none.

done.description: The board's column for the done state. Default: Done. May be none.

tickets.fields.description: Which of your board's fields the sync writes. Needs a board.

session.description: The board's field the sync writes for session. Default: Session. May be none.

runs-in.description: The board's field the sync writes for runs-in. Default: Runs in. May be none.

cost.description: The board's field the sync writes for cost. Default: Cost. May be none.

builds.description: What starts a build, and where it runs.

trigger.description: What starts a build for a ticket you moved to Ready. Default: manual.

runner.description: Where an unattended build runs. Default: github-actions.

specs.description: How the written spec for a visible change is kept.

type.description: How the spec for a visible change is kept. Default: none.

auto-merge.description: Which pull requests may merge without you.

allow.description: Patterns for files safe to merge unread.

deny.description: Exceptions inside allow. deny always wins.

commands.description: Your own checks. Each is run once for a pull request and can veto it.

ci-review.description: The automated review of every pull request: on when this is written, even with nothing under it.

commands.description: Commands the review may run, as prefixes, beside the factory's own, such as your tests.

site.description: How the factory looks at your website.

start.description: Builds and serves the site from the repository's root; $PORT is set.

design-guide.description: A file of your own design rules.

pages.description: The paths to look at. Otherwise from /sitemap.xml, or the home page's links.

widths.description: The widths, in pixels, each page is shot at. Default: [390, 1280].

hide.description: CSS selectors hidden before every picture, for something that floats.

checks.description: Your own measuring commands. Each gets one JSON object on its standard input.

max-pages.description: How many changed pages the agent reads closely. Default: 4.

start-minutes.description: How long to wait for the site to answer after start is run. Default: 5.

accessibility.description: The WCAG level axe-core measures each changed page against; none runs no accessibility rules. Default: wcag22aa.

new-values.description: Whether a font size, color, spacing, or corner radius the change brings in that the base site uses nowhere is reported. Default: true.

skill.description: The name of one of your own skills, in .claude/skills/.

agent.description: The name of one of your own agents, in .claude/agents/.

role.description: What the plug-in does: mockups, builder, or reviewer.

files.description: For a reviewer: it is considered when a change touches one of these.

labels.description: For a builder: it builds a ticket carrying one of these labels.

session-minutes.description: How long each kind of unattended session may run, in minutes. The job around it gets 10 more. GitHub's own runners stop a job at 6 hours, so a value above 350 does nothing there.

build.description: A build of a ticket. Default: 230.

conflicts.description: A fix of a pull request's conflicts with the default branch. Default: 110.

review.description: An answer to your review of a pull request. Default: 50.

dependencies.description: Work on the dependency pull requests. Default: 50.

rules.description: Numbers the process rules use, for a repository that wants different ones.

small-change-lines.description: A change under this many lines outside tests, specs, and content, adding no component and no state, takes the lighter path. Default: 30.

review-rounds.description: Rounds a session works a review before it hands what is left to you. Default: 2.
